summary: Intchains Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of CFO Chaowei Yan effective August 31, 2026, for personal reasons with no disagreement with the Company, and the immediate appointment of Ms. Yue Zhuo as CFO effective September 1, 2026. Ms. Zhuo, 34, previously served on the finance team since September 2022, and worked at Alibaba Group and Ernst & Young Hua Ming LLP. No terms, advisors, or board recommendation details were provided. Watch for integration of the new CFO and any strategic shifts.
